newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria ATX powers to record closing high.
newsitem.headline: Austria ATX powers to record closing high.

text.p: Austria's ATX index of 21 blue chips powered to an all-time closing high on Tuesday and analysts forecast the index has further room on the upside.
The ATX ended 30.17 points, or 2.3 percent, higher at 1,339.87 with buying encouraged after the index broke through resistance at 1,310 points at the opening.
Investmentbank Austria sees the ATX's short-term target at 1,400 points on the condition that the schedule for the introduction of Europe's single currency is adhered to.
* Top ATX gainer Wolford, up 80 schillings at 1,270.
* Most active ATX issue EVN, up 30 schillings at 1,610 on turnover of 104,097.
* July ATX future up 40 points at 1,347 on turnover of 1,915 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
